disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may discipline a licensee upon a finding of unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: upon a finding of unprofessional conduct by an applicant or license holder, impose a sanction provided by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly defrauding or abusing the workers' compensation system.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: suspend, revoke, or deny a license of a person who the board determines, after a hearing as provided in subsection (1)(b), is guilty of knowingly defrauding, abusing, or aiding in the defrauding or abusing of the workers' compensation system

disciplinary_grounds.description: Filing false information or failing to furnish required information in application or renewal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to furnish the required information, except pursuant to 37-1-138, or the filing of false information is grounds for denial or revocation of a license.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of architecture" means any professional service or creative work requiring the application of advanced knowledge of architectural design, building construction, and standards and involving the constant exercise of discretion and judgment in those activities, in which the safeguarding of life, health, or property is concerned, as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or inspection of construction for any public or private building.
